review_text: Went here lunch time and it’s kinda hot. The cold beverages compliment the weather though. I believe it’s a great spot for late afternoon hangout. Perfect also for travellers who wish to have a good coffee and just do drive-thru. Yummy cinnamon roll too!
Overlooking view and fresh air add to the overall calmib experience.

Very nice made place... with a very nice view.. and a highway in front. Most important for a coffee shop: The Coffee is really good! A good machine, someone who knows how to use the coffee machine... and, very rare in Davao: They also using a good coffee bean. All together make a smooth and tasty coffee, perfect base also for a good cappuccino. And their Mango Ice tea is also very refreshing. Not too sweet. The place itself is made very beautifull, clean, a little bit like a oasis in Davao. With a perfect long view out to the valley... give your eyes a rest from the city. And the other place... ok. it's the highway. Noice, dust, smoke... It is called a drive through, but they have also 4 parking lots and the mentioned nice, park-like ambience, and also a toilet.

The uneven surfaces of the long, not-so-winding Diversion road makes it an easy excuse for me not to take this route….Wanted to check the progress of the overpass after months of skipping this highway so, I made the drive….Glad I did ‘coz Bean Xpress sprouted out of nowhere in the South…. Opens 7 or 8 a.m. and closes at 11 p.m. or 1 a.m. (depending if it’s a weekDAY or weekEND)….Items are priced lower than other coffee places (hooray!). My sugar rush for the day—-Banoffee High and Lava Cake….Yummmm….. My terrible photos from inside the vehicle won’t help you appreciate the place…It’s along the road, you can drive-through during the day under the scorching heat of the sun…Or park in the evening and soak in the view…Either way, you should really check this place out.
Very affordable coffee and coffee is good for its price! The drive-thru option is our favorite specially since it’s on diversion road and we always pass by on our way to the airport. Keep it up!
Good area to have coffee, friendly staff and must try their cakes 🍰 👌. Coffee I would say 8.5/10.. Overall good place to have coffee. 5 stars ⭐️

Americano here with an amazing asawa and family.... The Iced White Mocha is better than Starbucks! The mango tea my asawa loves! The cookies and cream are a delight for the kids! Amazing view! Friendly staff, and great prices! I'll be sad not to get my daily coffee here when we return to the states, but we will be back!
